integrity: Analytic proof uses a uniform Duhamel remainder bound and elementary angle bounds; numerical matrix-exponential evaluation is an optional cross-check and not a proof.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample addresses universal waiting-time stochastic ordering only, not the squared coefficient of variation. An earlier 2018 preprint abstract asserts a related general stochastic order, but its complete text was inaccessible and conflicts with the authors' later statement of Conjecture 3.9. Priority beyond inspected material is unresolved.
title: A sixteen-phase cyclic MMPP reverses the conjectured stationary waiting-time order
